scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace packages/shared run build && npm --workspace packages/tools run build && npm --workspace packages/providers run build && npm --workspace packages/model-manager run build && npm --workspace packages/hermes-bridge run build && npm --workspace packages/agent run build && npm --workspace packages/core run build && npm --workspace apps/cli run build
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && npx tsc -p packages/tools --noEmit && npx tsc -p packages/providers --noEmit && npx tsc -p packages/model-manager --noEmit && npx tsc -p packages/hermes-bridge --noEmit && npx tsc -p packages/agent --noEmit && npx tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && npm --workspace apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:packages && npm run test:web
scripts.test:packages: npm --workspace packages/shared test && npm --workspace packages/tools test && npm --workspace packages/providers test && npm --workspace packages/model-manager test && npm --workspace packages/hermes-bridge test && npm --workspace packages/agent test && npm --workspace packages/core test
